notes: GAAP. Governmental: Total column of the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p4); ending_cash is cash and cash equivalents from the governmental funds Balance Sheet Total column (p3), investments 522,626,387 in the same column recorded in ending_investments for information; beginning cash not shown. Other financing = leases 904,559 + sale of capital assets 523,029; debt_proceeds = issuance of debt 385,240. Business-type: Total enterprise column of the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position (p11), internal service funds excluded; no single total printed, so totals are operating + nonoperating lines (negative nonoperating lines shown as positive expenses); other_financing = capital contributions less plant costs recovered. Proprietary cash flows p12 Total column. governmental_net_position from the Statement of Activities (p2). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (p1); Internal Balances net to zero in the Total column and are omitted. Detail (same approach as FY2025): General, Street Construction, West Haymarket JPA and Federal Grants funds from the p4 fund columns, so detail ties to p4; the budget-basis schedules (pp5-8) and the General Fund combining schedule (p15, sub-funds) are not used to avoid double counting the same funds on a different basis; nonmajor special revenue funds (17 fund columns, pp17-18) from their Total column as 'Nonmajor funds (combined)'; nonmajor debt service (p19), capital projects (p20) and permanent (p21) funds by fund (the p16 nonmajor-by-type statement is the sum of these). Zero/dash lines omitted. Pages 22-24 are statistical tables (no figures used); p14 is a narrative description of General Fund sub-funds. Read pages 1-24 of 24

report_discrepancies.note: Statement of Net Position rows do not cross-foot: Restricted for Other Governmental 24,239,619 + Business-type 2,945,000 = 27,184,619 but the Total column prints 26,050,529 (+1,134,090); Net Investment in Capital Assets 1,034,156,868 + 1,212,363,535 = 2,246,520,403 but the Total column prints 2,247,654,493 (-1,134,090). Each column foots to its printed total; the report itself does not add up across; column figures kept as printed.
